verdict.rationale: Reader documents an `x-json-schema` header that takes a JSON schema definition and uses ReaderLM-v2 to extract specific fields, which gives developers structured, schema-shaped output from scraped pages. Separately, `x-markdown-chunking` returns a JSON array of chunks, and `x-respond-with` lets callers select the output format. Missing for 10: a documented JSON response envelope or example payload, any explicit statement that schema extraction returns JSON (it is implied), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the extraction output.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as structured JSON

citations.quote: Use the `x-json-schema` header with a JSON schema definition, or use `x-instruction` header with natural language instructions. Both features work with ReaderLM-v2 to extract specific fields
Returns a JSON array (or ``-delimited text) of chunks instead of one blob
